proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can target objects, but it cannot create a persistent adhesive relationship between two objects that remains until a specific counteragent breaks it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects."

proposed_widenings.name: activation_effect_sets_after_duration
proposed_widenings.justification: The item applies now but its actual bonding effect starts only after a 1-minute setting period. The current activation surface has durations, but no honest delayed-application shape for a future stateful effect on the attached objects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set."

proposed_widenings.name: bond_break_only_by_named_counteragents
proposed_widenings.justification: Once the bond exists, its removal is gated by a closed list of named items/spells rather than ordinary expiry. The current surface lacks a created-effect lifecycle variant for that restriction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell."

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because any current encoding would omit or falsify the core mechanic: a permanent adhesive bond between two objects.
